description: This file defines a RecyclerView adapter named FilterAdapter used for displaying and managing filter options in a side navigation menu within an Android TV frontend application. It handles filter items such as 'All Recipes', 'Favorites', and various cuisines, allowing selection and highlighting of the current filter.

classes.name: FilterAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView adapter for displaying filter options in the side navigation menu.

classes.name: FilterAdapter.FilterViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder class for individual filter items in the RecyclerView.

classes.name: FilterAdapter.FilterItem
classes.description: Data class representing a filter item with a label and filter type.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new FilterViewHolder instance.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the ViewHolder, setting the filter label and selection state.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the number of filter items.

methods.name: updateCuisines
methods.description: Updates the filter list with new cuisines and default filters.

methods.name: updateSelectedFilter
methods.description: Updates the currently selected filter and refreshes the view.

methods.name: FilterViewHolder.bind
methods.description: Binds a filter item to the ViewHolder, setting text and click behavior.
